mentions.name: Yapress
mentions.description: Yapress is a Git-managed static site setup with a migration script for moving WordPress sites to a static build. It is still in progress, with the author testing the setup and validating the workflow; the noted trade-off of going static is losing comments.
mentions.problem: Migrating off WordPress to a Git-managed static setup, accepting the trade-off that going static loses comment support.
mentions.source_excerpt: I’ve started moving off WordPress to Yapress. It’s a Git-managed static setup with a migration script, though I haven’t run the full migration yet.

evidence.value: I’ve started moving off WordPress to Yapress. It’s a Git-managed static setup with a migration script, though I haven’t run the full migration yet.
